lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Li4Cu2As2O8 (reduced formula Li2CuAsO4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pmc2₁ (No. 143), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for As, Cu, and Li centers, each surrounded by six oxygen neighbors, with As–O distances near 1.76 Å and Cu–O distances near 1.92 Å. Oxygen centers coordinate to one As and one Cu or one As and one Li, while the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron contacts include edge-sharing between As and Li octahedra and corner-sharing between As and Cu octahedra.
